description:
Did Jesus actually take diseases upon Himself when healing the sick, like the leper in Luke 5:12–13? If so, why didn’t He become ill?

What does Hebrews 9:12 really mean when it says Jesus entered the Most Holy Place “once for all”? How does this align with the Adventist belief that Christ entered the Most Holy Place in 1844?
